title: PlayStation Architecture
summary: A detailed technical analysis of the original Sony PlayStation's hardware architecture, covering its MIPS R3000A CPU, custom GPU, SPU sound processor, and memory system design from the Copetti technical blog.
problem_solved: Provides comprehensive technical documentation of PlayStation hardware internals for developers and enthusiasts.
why_valuable: Offers rare deep-dive technical insights into 90s gaming console hardware, useful for retro game development and understanding gaming history evolution.
